name: Freedom
overview: Scripture reveals that true freedom is found through the work of God and the person of Jesus Christ. The Psalms describe God delivering His people from distress and granting them liberty as they seek His precepts, while Isaiah and Luke highlight the Spirit's mission to proclaim liberty to captives and healing to the brokenhearted. Jesus Himself declares that knowing the truth leads to freedom, and that if the Son sets one free, that freedom is genuine and complete.
